bio_glossgenius_verbatim:
I am a licensed Nail technician that has specialized in nail care for 9 years..... 
I specialize in my perfection to make sure each client is given the correct desired shape. I make my own acrylic system where I focus on the actual foundation and prepping versus designing first!!! 

* When booking with JNicole you must post a nonrefundable deposit... placing your credit card information when booking does now guarantee your deposit, your credit card information is for cancellation and no show purposes. Deposits must be paid at the time of booking via Cash App ($jazzedbyjnicole) or Apple Pay. 

* Any appointment cancelled the day of service will be charged a cancellation fee. Canceled appointments 2 hours or less before scheduled appointment or no shows will be charged 30% of scheduled appointment. 

*I DO NOT WORK OVER OTHERS WORK!! If wanting services you will have to come with a fresh clean acrylic free nail bed, or we will conduct a soak off before any services are performed. If a soak off is needed please come at least 45 mins before your designated appointment time. 

*NO kids or Extra Guests ALLOWED!! If any extras are to accompany on your scheduled appointment you will be asked to reschedule for a later date. 

*Any appointments booked or requested before 9am or after 7pm will be charged a $15 after hour fee.

*Any clients 15-20 mins late for appointments will be charged a $15 late fee any clients 30 min or more late will be forced to reschedule.

brand_vibe.description: Official brand mark (from Booksy's logo image and a Facebook-style cover graphic pulled from GlossGenius): a rose-gold/blush cursive 'Jazzed' wordmark with a gold serif 'By J. NICOLE' line, rose-gold sparkle dots and an illustrated hand with colorful nail art, all on a pure black background. The actual nail-art photography (from both GlossGenius service photos and Booksy inspiration photos) is vivid and maximalist: rhinestone-heavy stiletto and coffin sets, gold leaf, hand painted florals and abstract line art, ombre, in a wide range of bright colors. Conclusion: a DARK base (matching the brand's black backdrop) with a rose-gold/champagne-blush glam accent reads truest to the brand, distinct from the more muted bronze/gold of other dark-base builds in this system.

language_evidence: All 5 Booksy review quotes used are in English. The GlossGenius provider bio (Nicole's own words about her business and policies) is written entirely in English. The og:description on the GlossGenius booking page is in English. No Spanish-language content was found in any source (Booksy, GlossGenius, Facebook listing snippet). Tallahassee, FL is an English-majority market. English is registered as the primary language; the full Spanish translation is still provided via the mandatory bilingual toggle.

images_downloaded.sources: Two sources, since Instagram's feed API was blocked (see email_sources_tried): (1) Booksy business images object: logo (1), cover (1), inspiration photos (8) - all real client nail-art photos published by the business on its Booksy listing, downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent. (2) GlossGenius per-service images: 23 distinct non-placeholder image URLs found across the 33 services (a handful of services share a GlossGenius generic stock icon, identified by short numeric IDs like /service/206502/image/image.jpg instead of long hashed IDs, and were skipped as not real photos of this business), of which 18 were downloaded (4 turned out to be phone-screenshot style images with visible app UI, excluded during curation; 1 was an exact duplicate by md5 and removed). Plus the business's GlossGenius cover photo and provider avatar.
images_downloaded.curation_note: Visual curation performed by looking at every candidate image (not by filename) via a generated contact sheet plus individual full-resolution review. EXCLUDED from the gallery: gg-svc-1/2/3/5/6 (phone screenshots with visible OS status bar, Instagram Explore/Reels UI, or 'Add comment' overlay text burned into the frame), gg-svc-4 (a photo of loose nail polish pens, not a nail result), gg-svc-8 (phone camera-roll screenshot with a visible time/battery status bar), gg-svc-17 (two face closeups for a brow service, too close to a personal selfie to use safely), booksy-insp-1 (features counterfeit Chanel-logo nail art, avoided for brand/IP reasons), booksy-insp-2 and booksy-insp-8 (a glittery card/mat in the frame has the business name and phone number visibly printed/handwritten on it, counts as a caption-in-photo). gg-svc-16 (a personal face selfie of the owner) and the GlossGenius provider avatar were kept ONLY as a small round avatar in the Experience section, never as a gallery tile, per the hard rule against owner portraits in the gallery.
